headword: {書類選考|しょるいせんこう}

definitions.gloss: document screening; resume screening; selection based on written application
definitions.explanation: The initial stage of a hiring or selection process in which candidates are evaluated based on submitted documents such as resumes and cover letters, before being invited for an interview.

examples.japanese: {書類選考|しょるいせんこう}を{通過|つうか}した。
{書類選考|しょるいせんこう}の{結果|けっか}は{来週|らいしゅう}{中|ちゅう}にメールで{届|とど}きます。
examples.english: The results of the document screening will be sent by email within next week.

examples.japanese: {応募者|おうぼしゃ}が{多|おお}いため、まず{書類選考|しょるいせんこう}で{候補者|こうほしゃ}を{絞|しぼ}り{込|こ}んでから{面接|めんせつ}を{行|おこな}います。
examples.english: Because there are many applicants, we will first narrow down the candidates through document screening before conducting interviews.

notes:
The first stage of the hiring process in Japan, where employers evaluate candidates based on their submitted documents before deciding who to interview. Combines {書類|しょるい} (documents) and {選考|せんこう} (selection, screening).

USAGE:
- A standard part of the Japanese job-hunting ({就活|しゅうかつ}) process
- Applicants typically submit a {履歴書|りれきしょ} (resume) and {職務経歴書|しょくむけいれきしょ} (CV/work history)
- Passing the {書類選考|しょるいせんこう} leads to the interview stage ({面接|めんせつ})
- Also used for university admissions, scholarship applications, and competitions

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {書類選考|しょるいせんこう}を{通過|つうか}する: to pass the document screening
- {書類選考|しょるいせんこう}で{落|お}ちる: to fail at the document screening stage
- {書類選考|しょるいせんこう}の{結果|けっか}: document screening results
- {書類選考|しょるいせんこう}{免除|めんじょ}: exemption from document screening

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {選考|せんこう}: selection, screening — the broader term for any selection process
- {一次選考|いちじせんこう}: first round of screening — may or may not be document-based
- {面接|めんせつ}: interview — typically the stage after {書類選考|しょるいせんこう}
